blockers: The canonical standing pose has a large visual break between the red torso/waist and the green lower-body masses. It reads as a floating upper body over a seated, symmetrical V rather than a planted standing gambler.
The lower silhouette is dominated by two oversized green tubes with weak pelvis and knee articulation. The duster, trousers, and legs are not structurally distinguishable at native 1x.
At native 1x, the face collapses into a pale rectangular mask beneath the fedora. Eye placement, nose, mouth, and expression are not reliably readable.
The card/coin flourish is reduced to a few white pixels near the hand. It never reads as an identifiable prop or a silhouette-legible signature gesture.

The 8-direction locomotion is a rigid, low-amplitude shuffle. Hips and shoulders show little counter-rotation, and contact, passing, push-off, and recovery poses do not establish convincing weight transfer.
Feet are extremely small relative to the lower limbs and frequently look disconnected, toe-sliding, or hovering over the baseline. Zero anchor drift does not compensate for weak visual foot contact.
The idle and gesture strips lack meaningful anticipation, overshoot, settle, and follow-through. The intended theatrical, slippery rhythm is mostly absent.
There is effectively no readable secondary motion in the duster, fedora ribbon, or accessories. The character behaves like a rigid cutout rather than a loose, jaunty performer.
high_value_changes: Rebuild the body silhouette around a visible pelvis and continuous torso-to-coat connection. Reduce the lower-leg mass and V spread, clarify knees and shoe attachment, and introduce deliberate asymmetry in the standing pose.

Clarify the costume hierarchy at native scale: separate emerald duster from trousers with distinct shapes and value ramps, give the crimson vest a readable velvet plane, and prevent dark green and black masses from merging.

Redesign the face specifically for 1x readability with a clear eye band, nose or muzzle plane, mouth indication, and a deliberate gambler expression. Ensure the fedora brim does not erase the entire face.
Make the signature flourish a real readable object: use a compact card fan or coin with a distinct high-value silhouette, then animate a clear anticipation, flourish arc, overshoot, and settle.

Re-author the walk cycles from explicit contact and passing keys for every direction. Add hip displacement, shoulder counter-rotation, planted-sole flattening, heel/toe progression, and a clear lifted-foot recovery.
Add delayed secondary motion to the duster hem, ribbon, and prop hand so they trail the torso and resolve after the main action.
Judge every revision at native 1x before approving the 4x inspection render; the current gradients and tiny highlights create false confidence when enlarged.
optional_notes: Hard technical constraints are clean: measured height is 120.5px and reported ground-anchor drift is 0.0px.
The fedora contour and emerald/crimson color grouping are the only reliable identity hooks at native scale.
The presence of 105 rendered frames does not indicate usable animation; the key-pose and contact logic remains underdeveloped.
regressions_from_previous: No Round-02 visual sheets or comparative metrics were supplied, so regression clearance is unverified.
strongest_improvements: Exact height and ground-anchor compliance remove the primary technical failure risk.
The tilted fedora provides a potentially useful silhouette accent.
The crimson vest against the emerald costume gives the character a basic hue separation that can support a stronger redesign.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Rebuild the canonical native-1x silhouette and key poses first: connect the torso to a readable pelvis and duster, replace the symmetric V legs with an asymmetric planted stance, and make one card-or-coin hand action unmistakable before propagating the design through all locomotion frames.
